svg.title: From Driver Inquiry to Settled Vehicle Week
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-driver-qualification-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: From Driver Inquiry to Settled Vehicle Week; subtitle: One nested 100-inquiry cohort; every later stage is a subset of the preceding stage.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative counts describe a single prospect cohort, not verified acquisition performance or annual revenue capacity. Stage counts are 100, 60, 36, 18, and 12; total conversion is 12%. The first settled week can occur after day 30.; caption: Track unique applicants rather than form submissions. Record a dated exclusion reason at each transition so insurance ineligibility, missing credentials, and payment failures do not disappear inside one blended conversion percentage.; stages: label: Inbound inquiries; value: 100 unique applicants enter the dated source cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Deduplicate telephone numbers and applicant records in the CRM. Record service area, desired vehicle class, work schedule, and acquisition channel before screening.; label: Operating fit established; value: 60 applicants meet the initial jurisdiction and schedule criteria; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Retain 60% of inquiries after checking intended service, license category, platform status, weekly availability, and published insurer eligibility requirements.; label: Documents and screening complete; value: 36 applicants complete the authorized evidence collection process; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Retain 60% of the prior cohort after identity, license, MVR, and insurer review. Establish the permissible purpose under 15 U.S.C. 1681b before ordering a consumer report.; label: Vehicle offer accepted; value: 18 applicants accept documented vehicle and collection terms; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Retain 50% of screened applicants after disclosing weekly charges, deposits, deductible allocation, mileage terms, toll administration, and service downtime procedures.; label: First settled week completed; value: 12 drivers complete handover and produce reconciled cleared collections; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Retain two-thirds of accepted offers only after coverage activation, vehicle inspection, completed handover, and cleared first-week collections. An executed contract alone does not qualify as a settled vehicle week.

text.title: From Driver Inquiry to Settled Vehicle Week
text.tspan: From Driver Inquiry to Settled Vehicle Week

rect.title: label: Inbound inquiries; value: 100 unique applicants enter the dated source cohort; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Deduplicate telephone numbers and applicant records in the CRM. Record service area, desired vehicle class, work schedule, and acquisition channel before screening.

label: Operating fit established; value: 60 applicants meet the initial jurisdiction and schedule criteria; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Retain 60% of inquiries after checking intended service, license category, platform status, weekly availability, and published insurer eligibility requirements.

label: Documents and screening complete; value: 36 applicants complete the authorized evidence collection process; numeric value: 36.0; detail: Retain 60% of the prior cohort after identity, license, MVR, and insurer review. Establish the permissible purpose under 15 U.S.C. 1681b before ordering a consumer report.

label: Vehicle offer accepted; value: 18 applicants accept documented vehicle and collection terms; numeric value: 18.0; detail: Retain 50% of screened applicants after disclosing weekly charges, deposits, deductible allocation, mileage terms, toll administration, and service downtime procedures.

label: First settled week completed; value: 12 drivers complete handover and produce reconciled cleared collections; numeric value: 12.0; detail: Retain two-thirds of accepted offers only after coverage activation, vehicle inspection, completed handover, and cleared first-week collections. An executed contract alone does not qualify as a settled vehicle week.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative counts describe a single prospect cohort, not verified acquisition performance or annual revenue capacity. Stage counts are 100, 60, 36, 18, and 12; total conversion is 12%. The first settled week can occur after day 30.
